rationale: C14 is the strongest plausible template because it is an earlier order revoking a specific founding order for an intergovernmental body, closely matching the child's combined revocation-and-abolition structure. This is more concrete than merely sharing the generic act of revocation: both appear to use revocation of an earlier organizational order as the mechanism for terminating the entity it established. C13 and C20 are relevant revocation precedents, but the supplied material does not show a similarly close organizational-abolition pattern.
